notes: Local UniFi live suite. The runner binds tests/trading-suite/mandate.json (WETH/SOL/WBTC/USDT).
Swap is out of scope. Lend rates must be 4-decimal ticks (0.0001, 0.9900, …).
Lot sizes from live UniFi: spot 0.01, perp 0.1, USDT lend 100, WETH lend 0.05, SOL lend 1. Far-from-market limits rest; markets fill.

trades.name: spot_limit_buy
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=spot, side=buy, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.01, price=101, order_type=limit, account_id=17. Far-from-market resting buy. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not cancel. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: cancel_spot_buy
trades.prompt: Account 17. Call get_world_open_orders for spot WETH/USDT. Cancel the resting spot buy of 0.01 WETH at price 101 using cancel_world_order (product=spot, side=buy, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, account_id=17, order_id from the tool). Quote the cancel transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Confirm with get_world_open_orders that the 101 bid is gone.

trades.name: spot_limit_sell
trades.coverage: spot limit sell far above mark
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=spot, side=sell, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.01, price=49000, order_type=limit, account_id=17. Far-from-market resting sell. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not cancel. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: cancel_spot_sell
trades.prompt: Account 17. Call get_world_open_orders for spot WETH/USDT. Cancel the resting spot sell of 0.01 WETH at price 49000 using cancel_world_order (product=spot, side=sell, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, account_id=17, order_id from the tool). Quote the cancel transaction_hash or the error verbatim.

trades.name: perp_limit_long
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=perp, side=long, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.1, price=102, order_type=limit, account_id=17. Far-from-market resting long. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not cancel. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: cancel_perp_long
trades.prompt: Account 17. Call get_world_open_orders for perp WETH/USDT. Cancel the resting perp long of 0.1 WETH at price 102 using cancel_world_order (product=perp, side=long, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, account_id=17, order_id from the tool). Quote the cancel transaction_hash or the error verbatim.

trades.name: perp_limit_short
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=perp, side=short, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.1, price=49100, order_type=limit, account_id=17. Far-from-market resting short. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not cancel. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: cancel_perp_short
trades.prompt: Account 17. Call get_world_open_orders for perp WETH/USDT. Cancel the resting perp short of 0.1 WETH at price 49100 using cancel_world_order (product=perp, side=short, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, account_id=17, order_id from the tool). Quote the cancel transaction_hash or the error verbatim.

trades.name: borrow_limit
trades.coverage: lend book borrow at a rate that should rest
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=lend, side=borrow, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.1, price=0.0001, order_type=limit, account_id=17. Far-from-market resting borrow. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not cancel. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: cancel_borrow
trades.prompt: Call cancel_world_order exactly once: product=lend, side=borrow, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, interest_rate=0.0001, account_id=17. Quote the cancel transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: spot_limit_inferred
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=spot, side=buy, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.01, price=103, account_id=17. Omit order_type so limit is inferred from price. Far-from-market resting buy. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not cancel. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: cancel_spot_inferred
trades.prompt: Account 17. Call get_world_open_orders for spot WETH/USDT. Cancel the resting spot buy of 0.01 WETH at price 103 using cancel_world_order (product=spot, side=buy, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, account_id=17, order_id from the tool). Quote the cancel transaction_hash or the error verbatim.

trades.name: spot_market_buy
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=spot, side=buy, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.01, order_type=market, account_id=17. No price. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: spot_market_sell
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=spot, side=sell, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.01, order_type=market, account_id=17. No price. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: perp_buy_alias_roundtrip
trades.coverage: perp side=buy alias for long, then cancel in the same turn
trades.prompt: Account 17. First call execute_world_order exactly once: product=perp, side=buy, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.1, price=104, order_type=limit. Quote that transaction_hash. Then call get_world_open_orders for perp WETH/USDT and cancel_world_order for the resting 0.1 long at 104 (product=perp, side=buy, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, account_id=17). Quote the cancel transaction_hash. Both must succeed. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: list_tradable_markets
trades.coverage: list_world_assets plus spot/perp/lend books for each non-quote symbol
trades.prompt: Account 17. Call list_world_assets. Then for every listed base symbol other than USDT, call get_world_market for product=spot with quote_symbol=USDT when the book exists, and also get_world_rates. Reply with a single inventory: every asset symbol, and which of spot/perp/lend markets the tools showed as live. Numbers and symbols from tools only. Do not execute.

trades.name: lend_usdt_limit
trades.coverage: USDT lend book, 4-decimal rate far from market
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=lend, side=lend, base_symbol=USDT, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=100, price=0.9900, order_type=limit, account_id=17. Far-from-market resting lend. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not cancel. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: cancel_lend_usdt
trades.prompt: Call cancel_world_order exactly once: product=lend, side=lend, base_symbol=USDT, quote_symbol=USDT, interest_rate=0.9900, account_id=17. Quote the cancel transaction_hash or the error verbatim.

trades.name: lend_sol_limit
trades.coverage: SOL lend book, different spot asset
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=lend, side=lend, base_symbol=SOL, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.1, price=0.9900, order_type=limit, account_id=17. If QuantityTooLow or QuantityNotMultipleOfMin, retry once with quantity=1. Far-from-market resting lend. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not cancel. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: cancel_lend_sol
trades.prompt: Call cancel_world_order exactly once: product=lend, side=lend, base_symbol=SOL, quote_symbol=USDT, interest_rate=0.9900, account_id=17. Quote the cancel transaction_hash or the error verbatim.

trades.name: lend_weth_limit
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=lend, side=lend, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.05, price=0.9900, order_type=limit, account_id=17. Far-from-market resting lend. If QuantityTooLow or QuantityNotMultipleOfMin, retry once with quantity=0.1. Do not increase size on BalanceTooLow. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not cancel. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: cancel_lend_weth
trades.prompt: Call cancel_world_order exactly once: product=lend, side=lend, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, interest_rate=0.9900, account_id=17. Quote the cancel transaction_hash or the error verbatim.

trades.name: open_perp_long_market
trades.coverage: open a filled perp long (then close in the next case)
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=perp, side=long, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.1, order_type=market, account_id=17. No price. This opens a live long. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not close it in this turn. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: close_perp_long_market
trades.coverage: close the perp long opened in the previous case
trades.prompt: Account 17. Call get_world_account. Then flatten the WETH perp long from the previous turn: execute_world_order product=perp, side=short, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.1, order_type=market, account_id=17. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: market_borrow_weth
trades.coverage: fill a WETH borrow so a loan exists
trades.prompt: Call execute_world_order exactly once: product=lend, side=borrow, base_symbol=WETH, quote_symbol=USDT, quantity=0.1, order_type=market, account_id=17. No price — this should fill against the lend book. Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim. Do not pay or close yet. Do not preview instead of execute.

trades.name: pay_weth_loan_interest
trades.coverage: pay interest on the borrower loan (no extend)
trades.prompt: Account 17. Call get_world_loans. Then call pay_world_loan_interest with account_id=17, base_symbol=WETH, extend_period=false. Do not pass a position_id unless it is a numeric on-chain id (ignore agg: ids). Quote transaction_hash from the pay tool, or the error verbatim. Do not close the loan in this turn.

trades.name: close_weth_loan
trades.coverage: close the borrower loan opened earlier
trades.prompt: Account 17. Call get_world_loans. Then call close_world_loan with account_id=17 and base_symbol=WETH. Do not pass a position_id unless it is a numeric on-chain id (ignore agg: ids). Quote transaction_hash or the error verbatim.
